Description: Variations in grid voltage can cause solar inverters to disconnect, leading to energy losses.
Potential Solution: Use smart inverters with voltage regulation capabilities.

Description: Grid frequency instability affects inverter operation, sometimes forcing PV systems to shut down.
Potential Solution: Implement grid-supportive inverters and battery storage.

Description: Grid operators may limit the amount of solar energy fed into the grid during oversupply periods.
Potential Solution: Improve grid flexibility and adopt energy storage solutions.

Description: High solar penetration can overload transmission lines, restricting energy exports.
Potential Solution: Upgrade grid infrastructure and introduce demand-side management.

Description: Grid-tied solar PV systems shut down during blackouts, preventing power supply even when sunlight is available.
Potential Solution: Deploy battery storage or implement microgrid capabilities for backup power.
